svg.title: Regular and irregular meshes with identical cell counts
svg.desc: Three rows compare structured quadrilateral grids and irregular triangular meshes with identical cell counts.
svg.text: Synthetic side-by-side: regular quadrilateral grids versus irregular triangular meshes with exactly the same number of cells.
Interpretation: identical cell counts do not imply identical accuracy. Cell shape, topology, boundary alignment, and field transfer also matter.
